title: Graph dependency rules
description: Rules `octocode-graph check` evaluates over a saved graph, in dependency-cruiser's vocabulary. Paths are JavaScript regular expressions over node ids: root-relative file paths, and pkg:<name> for packages (pkg:node:fs for a runtime module).

forbidden.description: Dependencies that must not exist: each match is a violation of its rule.

allowed.description: Dependencies that may exist: a dependency no rule here matches is a `not-in-allowed` violation.

allowedSeverity.description: The severity of `not-in-allowed` violations; default warn.

required.description: Dependencies that must exist: each module matching `module` must depend on a module matching `to`.

severity.description: error fails the check (exit 1) unless the baseline lists the violation; warn and info are reported only.

load.description: Which imports count: runtime (default) the ones that run (no import type); eager also drops import(); all every import and compile-time dependency.

pattern.description: A regular expression over node ids; an array matches when any of its items does.

kinds.description: Import kinds as the graph records them (static-import, type-import, dynamic-import, commonjs-require, rust-use, external-builtin, …): a dependency matches when one of its kinds is listed.

pathNot.description: Modules whose id does not match.

via.description: A module of the cycle matches when its id matches path and not pathNot.

path.description: Targets whose id matches; $1…$9 stand for the groups from.path captured ($0 the whole match).

pathNot.description: Targets whose id does not match; takes $1…$9 too.

reachable.description: true: a target reached through any chain of imports is a violation; false: a target no from-module reaches is one.

circular.description: true: a dependency that leads back to its source.

via.description: With circular: some module of the cycle matches.

viaOnly.description: With circular: every module of the cycle matches.

reachable.description: true: any chain of imports satisfies the rule, not only a direct one.

name.description: The rule's id in reports, baselines and SARIF.
